description: This Java class 'ExecutionPool' manages thread pools, scheduled executors, and delay queues for concurrent task execution within the OFBiz framework. It includes thread factory setup, future result collection, and pulse-based delayed task handling.

classes.name: ExecutionPool
classes.description: Manages thread pools, scheduled executors, and delay queues for concurrent task execution, including thread factory creation and pulse handling.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.ExecutionPoolThreadFactory
classes.description: Creates daemon threads with specific naming for thread pools.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.ExecutionPoolPulseWorker
classes.description: Worker that processes 'Pulse' objects from a delay queue.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.Pulse
classes.description: Abstract class representing a delayed, runnable task with expiration logic.

methods.name: getScheduledExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures a scheduled thread pool executor with optional pre-start and keep-alive settings.

methods.name: getAllFutures
methods.description: Collects results from a collection of Future objects, handling exceptions.

methods.name: addPulse
methods.description: Adds a Pulse object to the delay queue for scheduled execution.

methods.name: removePulse
methods.description: Removes a Pulse object from the delay queue.
